llm_reason: Round-9 DFN verification rejected both SPMe finalists on the same three criteria (plateau 4.0766 vs 4.1, T_max 330.57 vs 323.15, amin -0.0522 plated=True). Root cause: DFN resolves electrolyte concentration gradients and full electrode polarization that SPMe averages away — at 18 A the cell's areal current (175 A/m2) produces a 36 s CC phase that drives the anode negative and dissipates ~12 K of heat at h=100. SPMe is discredited as the screening layer for this cell class; rounds 10+ run DFN. Fix directions: (a) transport (sigma 2.0/t+ 0.5) for plateau+heat; (b) N/P 1.28 for plating (SEI budget available: DFN 191 nm vs 500); (c) thin-and-wide repack — volume/capacity-conserving geometry change that attacks areal current density directly, the engineering-correct fix for all three failures at once; (d) h 250 forced cooling as the parameter-route backstop.
